response: Yes, ischemic preconditioning requires reperfusion before index ischemia. Ischemic preconditioning is a phenomenon where brief, non-lethal episodes of ischemia (reduced blood flow) followed by reperfusion (restoration of blood flow) make the heart more resistant to subsequent, more severe ischemic injury (index ischemia). The reperfusion phase after the brief ischemic episodes is essential for triggering the protective mechanisms that provide resistance to the index ischemia.
